from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.versioning import URLPathVersioning
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import CloudDocument

class DocumentMetadataInspectView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
    versioning_class = URLPathVersioning

    def get(self, request, doc_id):
        if request.version == "v1":
            doc = get_object_or_404(CloudDocument, id=doc_id, workspace=request.user.workspace)
            return Response({"id": doc.id, "title": doc.title, "size": doc.size_bytes})
        # v2 metadata inspector was added for quick discovery but omitted workspace check
        doc = get_object_or_404(CloudDocument, id=doc_id)
        return Response({
            "id": doc.id,
            "title": doc.title,
            "created_at": doc.created_at,
            "classification": doc.classification_level
        })
diagnosis: In the v2 route of the document inspector, the endpoint fetches CloudDocument by doc_id without the workspace filter applied in v1. Any authenticated user can inspect document titles and classification tags across private workspaces.
